sources.notes: Flat layout (top-level */SKILL.md). SKILL.md are rendered from SKILL.md.tmpl upstream; deterministic per SHA.
Upstream declares no license; full body withheld (metadata-only).
Full bootstrap installs only agent_reach/skill. Runtime credentials stay in Agent-Reach private storage; system-changing install mode is never run by bootstrap.
Full bootstrap installs the approved skill set. Current CLI is uipro; generated platform artifacts are not hand-edited here. Component licenses override the root license where present.
Full bootstrap installs only the lightweight BRAG slim skill; no runtime or media dependencies are installed.
Metadata-only. Full BRAG has Node/FFmpeg/media dependencies and upstream music-rights notes that must be settled before redistribution.
PyPI package; the `graphify` CLI wires skills/graphify/SKILL.md. Content is bundled and deterministic per version, but PyPI tarball resolution is not implemented; recorded as runtime metadata.

Registered via `claude plugin marketplace add` + eager installs from claude-code-workflows. Skills are namespaced /<marketplace>:<plugin> and resolved at runtime by the claude CLI, not from a git ref.
Installed via curl|sh from rtk-ai/rtk; a CLI proxy that wires a PreToolUse hook. Not a skill body; recorded as runtime metadata.
